name: smwmusic-banshiryuu-death-twins
title: Banshiryuu - Death Twins
description:
The theme of the third extra stage bosses, Mei and Mai, in the third Seihou game, Banshiryuu. I don't think any of the three people who know about this game expected a port from it to ever exist, eh?

This song is overall a mess, both compositionally and mixing-wise, and while I did try to clean up the mixing at least, it's still a bit all over the place.

It's a short and repetitive, high-energy song with a short "break" where it gets quiet.

Probably best suited for a short, hyper boss.
